title: Submission metadata
description: Metadata of one submission. Only 'title' and 'origin' are required; everything else is defaulted from validation.config.yaml or taken from contributor.yaml.

title.description: Short human readable title of the submission.

origin.description: Where the example comes from. 'real-world' and 'derived-from-real' earn rating level 1.

description.description: One or two sentences. Longer prose belongs in README.md.

items.description: Package id and pinned version, e.g. hl7.fhir.fi.base#2.0.0. Floating versions (#current, #dev, #latest) are rejected.

igs.description: Additional implementation guides, loaded on top of the defaults for this FHIR version.

country.description: The country whose rules or systems the example comes from, as an upper case ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code such as FI or AU.

enforceProfile.description: Defaults to true: every document Bundle is also validated against the profile in validation.config.yaml enforcedProfiles.documentBundle. Set to false to validate only against the declared profiles.

custodian.description: Who answers questions about this submission. Defaults to contributor.yaml.

file.description: File name inside this submission, matched exactly.

location.description: FHIRPath expression or 'Line n, Column m'. Supports * wildcards.

justification.description: Why this issue is accepted. Required.

knownIssues.description: Issues that are known and accepted. All given matchers must match. Suppressed issues do not affect the status but are counted and shown.

normalizedVersion.description: Path of an improved variant of this submission.
